<!-- Repair 23: The logo comes from the installed Tally executable,
                                         not a synthetic letter or an external network image. -->
                                    <Button Grid.Column="1"
                                            Width="48"
                                            Height="32"
                                            Margin="8,0,3,0"
                                            Padding="0"
                                            VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                            Command="{Binding DataContext.OpenLinkedTallyCommand, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType={x:Type Window}}}"
                                            ToolTip="Open the Tally company linked to the active Client/FY">
                                        <Grid>
                                            <Image x:Name="TallyInstalledLogoImage" Width="27" Height="27" Stretch="Uniform" Visibility="Collapsed"/>
                                            <TextBlock x:Name="TallyLogoFallback" Text="Tally" FontFamily="Segoe Script" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="#174E8C" VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                                        </Grid>
                                    </Button>
                                    <ToggleButton x:Name="TallyLauncherInfoButton"
                                                  Grid.Column="2"
                                                  Width="29" Height="32"
                                                  Margin="0,0,6,0" Padding="0"
                                                  VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                                  Cursor="Hand"
                                                  Tag="{Binding DataContext, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType={x:Type Window}}}"
                                                  ToolTip="Tally launcher information">
                                        <iconPacks:PackIconMaterial Kind="InformationOutline" Width="17" Height="17"/>
                                    </ToggleButton>
                                    <Popup x:Name="TallyLauncherInfoPopup"
                                           Grid.Column="2"
                                           PlacementTarget="{Binding ElementName=TallyLauncherInfoButton}"
                                           DataContext="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}"
                                           Placement="Bottom"
                                           HorizontalOffset="-270"
                                           VerticalOffset="6"
                                           AllowsTransparency="True"
                                           PopupAnimation="Fade"
                                           StaysOpen="False"
                                           IsOpen="{Binding IsChecked, ElementName=TallyLauncherInfoButton, Mode=TwoWay}">
                                        <Border Width="355" Padding="14" CornerRadius="10"
                                                Background="{DynamicResource SurfaceBrush}"
                                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="1">
                                            <StackPanel>
                                                <TextBlock Text="Open linked Tally" FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="14" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                                <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,5" FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="11" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                                    <Run Text="Client: "/>
                                                    <Run Text="{Binding CurrentClient, Mode=OneWay}"/>
                                                    <Run Text="  |  FY: "/>
                                                    <Run Text="{Binding CurrentFinancialYear, Mode=OneWay}"/>
                                                </TextBlock>
                                                <TextBlock Text="The logo opens or brings forward Tally for the active Client/FY. It never exports, creates, modifies or deletes vouchers."
                                                           TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="If the linked company is already loaded, AAH brings Tally forward. If the saved Company Number is available, AAH requests that exact company when launching Tally."
                                                           TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="If Company Number is missing, Tally opens without selecting a company automatically. Choose the exact linked company in Tally, refresh AAH, and press Link to update its launch information."
                                                           TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="The company link, MASTERID checks, manual export and automatic sync are unchanged. Tally.ini is never edited."
                                                           TextWrapping="Wrap" Foreground="{DynamicResource TextSecondaryBrush}" FontSize="10"/>
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </Border>
                                    </Popup>
